top_signals.title: Guard appears to rebuke Hegseth’s delegation at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army sentinel moved toward the group and, from a distance, shouted toward them: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: London Infrastructure Investment Firm Arcus Said to Weigh Sale
top_signals.summary: Arcus Infrastructure Partners is weighing strategic options including a potential sale, people familiar with the matter said, in what could be the latest sign of consolidation among private capital managers.
